claims: Mexico will play Belgium in an international friendly on Tuesday, March 31, 2026.
The international friendly between Mexico and Belgium is at 8:00 PM CT.
The international friendly between Mexico and Belgium is at Soldier Field in Chicago, Illinois.
The event is International Friendly / MexTour 2026.
Mexico has seen limited scoring since the 2025 Gold Cup.
Belgium had a high-scoring win against the USMNT.
Mexico and Belgium last met in 2017.
Mexico and Belgium's 2017 meeting ended in a 3-3 draw.
Mexico faces absences including Edson Álvarez and Luis Malagón.
Belgium will be without Leandro Trossard.
Mexico's probable lineup includes Jose Rangel (GK), Johan Vásquez, César Montes, Jorge Sánchez, Raúl Jiménez, Julian Quinones.
Tickets for the match are currently on sale through Ticketmaster
